Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in interpreting the genealogical data presented in the Wikipedia infobox. In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly identified "Concepción S enz de Tejada" as the maternal grandmother. The Wikipedia text explicitly states that Felipe is the "maternal-line grandson of King Juan Carlos I and Queen Sof a," which directly identifies Queen Sof a as the maternal grandmother. The text further clarifies that his paternal grandmother is Concepción S enz de Tejada. The Planner failed to distinguish between the maternal and paternal lines, likely misaligning the grandparent pairs in the infobox or misreading the explicit text stating the maternal lineage. This contradicts the correct information found in the same source (Queen Sof a) and represents a failure in basic logical deduction and source interpretation.
